resumePrompt: Auto-resume by Session Guardian. Read SESSION-STATE.md in this directory, do the next 1-2 planned steps from its 'Next steps' section, update the checkpoint, then stop. Do not start unrelated work.

_docs.thresholdPct: Fire the brake when usedPct crosses this. usedPct = max(time-elapsed% of the 5h block, cost-burn% if a budget is set).
_docs.costBudgetPer5hWindowUSD: null = brake on TIME only (safe default, no false alarms). Set a number (e.g. 50) once you've observed your plan to also brake on spend/burn. ccusage costUSD is used because raw token counts are dominated by cache reads.
_docs.autonomous: true = auto-resume the session at reset. false = only checkpoint (no scheduled resume).
_docs.maxAutoCycles: Hard cap on consecutive autonomous resumes before Guardian stops re-arming, so a runaway loop can't burn windows forever.
_docs.projectAllowlist: Empty = resume allowed from any project dir. Add absolute cwd paths to restrict autonomous resume to those projects only.
_docs.killSwitchFile: If a file with this name exists in the project dir OR the Guardian data dir, no arm and no resume happen.
_docs.manageStatusLine: true = auto-add a live '⏳ 55% · reset 15:00' status line to ~/.claude/settings.json on session start (self-healing, never overrides a status line you set yourself). Set false to manage it manually.
_docs.senseCacheSeconds: ccusage is only re-run this often; hooks read a cached result in between so they stay fast.
_docs.resumeBufferMinutes: Schedule the resume this many minutes AFTER the estimated reset time.
